canonical_project: Ilsan Data Centre / Magna PFV Deok-i-dong
notes: DCD reports Magna PFV received final approval for a five-story 16,945 sqm Deok-i-dong data center after prior cancellation/rejection attempts and resident opposition. Cushman & Wakefield lists the same Goyang/Ilsan project at 12MW and under construction in 1H 2025.
